purpose: Explicit causal definition of confirmed swings and basic market-structure labels for forward observation.

swing_confirmation.confirmation_rule: A candle is confirmed as SWING_HIGH only when its high is strictly greater than the highs of the two preceding and two following closed candles. SWING_LOW is the analogous strict-low rule.
swing_confirmation.observation_timing: The pivot candle is labeled only when the right-side confirmation candles are already closed and included in the current observation.

labels.high: higher high => HH; otherwise lower high => LH
labels.low: higher low => HL; otherwise lower low => LL

events.bos: BOS is recorded when a newly confirmed swing breaks the most recent opposite structural reference in its direction.
events.choch: CHOCH is recorded when the first confirmed break is opposite the current inferred directional regime.
events.ambiguous: If the structural direction is unknown or the reference is unavailable, emit no BOS/CHOCH.
